calculation.description: For each tradable instrument, use negative ten-day return normalized by 30-day daily volatility. Activate the signal when the equal-weight cross-asset mean five-day rolling return volatility exceeds its trailing 60-observation 60th percentile, with the threshold lagged one observation. Cross-sectionally demean active signals. Forward validation horizon is 20 trading days.

validation.regime_notes: Aggregate gate passes across 221 dates and the 15-instrument universe, but recent 27-date IC is strongly negative and 2027-2029 IC is weak; retain only with heightened drift monitoring. 2025-2026 is strongly positive but contains only 24 observations.
